notes: 1. Offers is a single-page module at /admin/offers (heading 'Offers Management'). No tabs, NO search/filter input — only Refresh + Add New Offer in the header (see DOC_DRIFT-004).

2. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT offer/record must be supplied before executing this destructive test (a throwaway offer to edit/toggle/delete, a buyer with a completed booking, a future/expired-dated offer).
3. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS or contradicted across sources; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

4. Offer Type is a radio group (AMOUNT default | PERCENTAGE) — mutually exclusive. Selecting one swaps the value field label/control (Amount with '₹ ' prefix  <->  Percentage). Amount-Based rows show Amount=₹X,XXX & Percentage='-'; Percentage-Based rows show Amount='-' & Percentage='X%'.

5. Destructive tests (Create / Edit-save / Toggle / Delete) MUST be authorised by the user before running on UAT and use a disposable offer — UAT offers are live and toggling/deleting affects real allocation pricing instantly (BRD §8 CRITICAL). Per pipeline discipline, destructive UI cases here are authored as OPEN-modal/drawer -> assert -> CLOSE (Cancel) only; actual submit/delete requires explicit user OK + disposable data.

6. Add and Edit both use an Ant DRAWER (.ant-drawer-content), NOT a centered modal. Delete uses an Ant MODAL (.ant-modal-content) with exact buttons 'Cancel' and 'Yes, delete' (NOT 'OK'/'Delete'/'Yes').
7. Toggle Active/Inactive has NO confirmation dialog — state flips instantly and persists to server (BRD §5.2, FS Feature 4).

8. Typology is a SINGLE-select Ant dropdown (one unitTypologyId scalar), NOT multi-select; empty = applies to all typologies. To target multiple typologies admin must create multiple offers (BRD §10.1, latest correction — see DOC_DRIFT-002). FRD/FS 'Multi-select' wording is stale.

9. Delete persistence is CONTESTED across sources: BRD §10.4 (2026-05-21, latest) = HARD destroy (offer.destroy(), no soft-delete, no FK guard, Sr.No gaps permanent). FRD §10 / FS Feature 5 §6.4 = soft-delete (paranoid, deletedAt). TCs assert the OBSERVED UI effect (offer disappears, Sr.No gap remains) and flag the DB-layer claim [VERIFY WITH DEV] (see DOC_DRIFT-001).

10. offerCode whitelist is CONTESTED: FS Feature 2 §6.8 + §Create claim admin offers always have offerCode=NULL (HOME_LOAN/VC_REQUEST system-only). BRD §10.2 (latest) says offerCode is read straight from req.body with NO whitelist — an admin CAN set offerCode='HOME_LOAN'. Negative API TCs assert the current permissive behaviour and flag for whitelist verification (see DOC_DRIFT-003).

11. No buyer/SM notification (SMS/WhatsApp/email) is dispatched for ANY offer action (create/edit/toggle/delete) — silence is by design (FS Features 2-5 §8). Silence-by-design is a REQUIRED assertion, not an omission.
12. System-generated offers HOME_LOAN (home-loan approval) and VC_REQUEST (SM video-call outcome) appear in the list but are NOT created via the Add New Offer drawer (BRD §4).

tcs.scenario: To verify re-activating an offer via the toggle
tcs.description: Verify that an inactive offer can be switched back ON via the toggle.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] user authorisation + a disposable inactive offer.
tcs.steps:
1. In an inactive offer's Action column, click the toggle switch.
2. Observe the toggle state.
tcs.expected: The toggle flips to ON instantly with no confirmation; the offer becomes active again (ant-switch-checked).

tcs.scenario: To verify toggle state persists after refresh
tcs.description: Verify that a toggled state is saved to the server and survives a page refresh.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] user authorisation + a disposable offer just toggled.
tcs.steps:
1. Toggle a disposable offer OFF.
2. Click 'Refresh' (or reload the page).
3. Observe the offer's toggle state.
tcs.expected: After refresh the offer still shows OFF — the toggle persisted to the server (FS Feature 4 §5).

tcs.scenario: To verify the toggle control is distinct from the edit/delete icons
tcs.description: Verify that the Action cell contains three distinct controls and that the toggle is not an icon-only button.
tcs.precond: An admin is on the Offers page with at least one offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Inspect the Action cell of an offer row.
2. Identify the toggle switch, the edit icon and the delete icon.
tcs.expected: The Action cell shows three controls in a row: an Active/Inactive toggle switch, an Edit icon (opens the Edit drawer) and a Delete icon (opens the delete confirmation). The toggle is a switch, not an icon-only button.

tcs.scenario: To verify the delete (trash) icon is present per row
tcs.description: Verify that each offer row shows a delete icon in the Action column.
tcs.precond: An admin is on the Offers page with at least one offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Inspect the Action column of any offer row.
2. Identify the delete (trash) icon (the second icon-only button).
tcs.expected: A delete (trash) icon is visible in the Action column of every offer row (second icon-only button, after the Edit icon).

tcs.scenario: To verify the delete icon opens the confirmation modal
tcs.description: Verify that clicking the delete icon opens an Ant modal asking to confirm deletion.
tcs.precond: An admin is on the Offers page with at least one offer.
tcs.steps:
1. In an offer row's Action column, click the delete (second icon-only) button.
2. Observe the dialog that appears.
tcs.expected: An Ant modal opens with title 'Are you sure you want to delete this offer?', body 'This action cannot be undone.', and two buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Yes, delete'. NON-DESTRUCTIVE: dismiss with Cancel/Escape.

tcs.scenario: To verify the exact delete confirmation text and buttons
tcs.description: Verify the precise title, body and button labels of the delete confirmation modal.
tcs.precond: The delete confirmation modal is open for an offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Read the modal title.
2. Read the modal body text.
3. Read the two button labels.
tcs.expected: Title reads exactly 'Are you sure you want to delete this offer?'; body reads exactly 'This action cannot be undone.'; buttons are labelled 'Cancel' and 'Yes, delete' (the confirm button is danger-styled). Note: the modal does NOT echo the offer's name (former ADM_OFR_045 'shows offer name' claim corrected — see DOC_DRIFT-005).

tcs.scenario: To verify Cancel on the delete modal keeps the offer
tcs.description: Verify that clicking Cancel in the delete modal closes it without deleting the offer.
tcs.precond: The delete confirmation modal is open for an offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Click 'Cancel' in the modal.
2. Observe the offer list.
tcs.expected: The modal closes and the offer remains in the list unchanged (no deletion).

tcs.scenario: To verify Escape key dismisses the delete modal without deleting
tcs.description: Verify that pressing Escape closes the delete confirmation modal and the offer is not deleted.
tcs.precond: The delete confirmation modal is open for an offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Press the Escape key.
2. Observe the offer list.
tcs.expected: The modal closes via Escape and the offer remains in the list (INDEX.md: dismissal by Escape or Cancel does NOT delete).

tcs.scenario: To verify confirming delete removes the offer
tcs.description: Verify that clicking 'Yes, delete' removes the offer from the list and the count decrements.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] user authorisation + a disposable offer. The delete confirmation modal is open for that offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Click 'Yes, delete'.
2. Observe the offer list and the count badge.
tcs.expected: The offer is removed from the list and the count badge decrements. The Sr.no of the deleted offer leaves a permanent gap. AUTHORISED-DELETE ONLY: requires user OK + disposable offer; otherwise author as open-modal -> assert text/buttons -> Cancel. (Whether removal is hard or soft delete at the DB layer is contested — see DOC_DRIFT-001 / ADM_OFR_044.)

tcs.scenario: To verify an Active offer can be deleted directly
tcs.description: Verify that deleting an offer does not require deactivating it first.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] user authorisation + a disposable Active offer. The delete confirmation modal is open.
tcs.steps:
1. With an Active (ON) offer, open its delete confirmation and click 'Yes, delete'.
2. Observe the list.
tcs.expected: An Active offer is deleted directly without first toggling it OFF; it is removed from the list (no deactivation pre-requisite, no server-side guard — FS Feature 5 §3).

tcs.scenario: To verify there is no FK guard preventing deletion of a referenced offer
tcs.description: Verify the documented behaviour that deleting an offer referenced by bookings is not blocked.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable offer referenced by a RegistrationUnitOffer row.
tcs.steps:
1. Open the delete confirmation for an offer that is referenced by an existing booking.
2. Click 'Yes, delete' (only if authorised).
tcs.expected: [To verify] Per BRD §10.4 the delete has NO FK guard — the offer is removed even when referenced by bookings, which may orphan downstream pricing rows. Confirm whether a guard exists. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify NO buyer notification on any offer action
tcs.description: Verify that creating, editing, toggling or deleting an offer dispatches no SMS, WhatsApp or email to buyers or SMs.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] access to dispatch/notification logs (Kaleyra/epinet/email).
tcs.steps:
1. Perform each offer action in turn (create, edit, toggle, delete) on a disposable offer.
2. Inspect the notification/dispatch logs for each.
tcs.expected: NO buyer- or SM-facing notification (SMS/WhatsApp/email) is dispatched for ANY offer action — silence is by design (FS Features 2-5 §8). This is a required silent-by-design assertion. [VERIFY WITH DEV] log access.

tcs.scenario: To verify whether admin can set a system offerCode via API
tcs.description: Verify the contested behaviour of whether the create/update API accepts an admin-supplied offerCode such as HOME_LOAN.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a valid admin API bearer token.
tcs.steps:
1. Call the create-offer endpoint with a body that includes offerCode='HOME_LOAN' (plus valid offer fields).
2. Inspect the created record's offerCode.
3. Repeat with offerCode='VC_REQUEST'.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin bearer token; offerCode HOME_LOAN / VC_REQUEST
tcs.expected: [To verify] CONTESTED: BRD §10.2 (latest) says offerCode is read from req.body with NO whitelist, so the admin-set value persists (HOME_LOAN/VC_REQUEST accepted). FS Feature 2 §6.8 claims it is stripped to NULL. Assert the OBSERVED result and flag for whitelist confirmation (DOC_DRIFT-003). [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify projectId query-parameter handling on list API
tcs.description: Verify how the list-offers endpoint resolves the projectId query parameter.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin bearer token and a known project id form.
tcs.steps:
1. Call the list-offers endpoint with projectId as a numeric PK.
2. Call it with projectId as the public business id.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin bearer token; both projectId forms
tcs.expected: [To verify] Endpoint accepts page, limit and projectId params (BRD §10.3). Confirm which projectId form resolves (numeric PK vs public id) and the error for an unknown project. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify the DB-layer delete persistence (soft vs hard)
tcs.description: Verify whether a deleted offer is soft-deleted (deletedAt set) or hard-destroyed at the database layer.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] DB read access and a disposable offer just deleted via UI.
tcs.steps:
1. Note the deleted offer's id.
2. Query the offers row for that id (including soft-deleted rows).
tcs.expected: [To verify] CONTESTED: BRD §10.4 (latest, 2026-05-21) says delete is a HARD destroy (offer.destroy(), no deletedAt, no audit). FRD §10 / FS Feature 5 §6.4 say soft-delete (paranoid, deletedAt set). Assert the OBSERVED DB state and flag the conflict (DOC_DRIFT-001). [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify UI-vs-backend date-order validation split
tcs.description: Verify whether the backend enforces Start<=End when the UI picker is bypassed via the API.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin bearer token.
tcs.steps:
1. Call the create-offer endpoint directly with startDate later than endDate.
2. Observe the response.
tcs.expected: [To verify] BRD §10.6 says the service layer has NO startDate<=endDate check — validation lives in controller/validator middleware. Confirm whether the HTTP layer rejects the out-of-order range (it should) and that the service is not callable to bypass it. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify offers API rejects an invalid/expired token
tcs.description: Verify that the offers endpoints reject unauthenticated or invalid-token requests.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV] No bearer token, and a tampered/expired token.
tcs.steps:
1. Call the list-offers endpoint with no Authorization header.
2. Call it with a tampered/expired bearer token.
tcs.expected: [To verify] Both calls are rejected with 401/403 and no offer data is returned. Exact status/error body not documented — confirm. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify offer toggle/edit emits no audit log
tcs.description: Verify the documented gap that toggle and create/edit operations emit no service-level audit entry.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] audit-log read access and a disposable offer.
tcs.steps:
1. Toggle a disposable offer and inspect the audit log.
2. Edit the same offer and inspect the audit log.
tcs.expected: [To verify] BRD §10.5/§10.6 state toggleOfferStatus and createOffer/editOffer emit NO service-level audit, contradicting FRD §Feature 4 §9 / FS §9 which claim audit logging. Assert the OBSERVED audit behaviour and flag the conflict. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify a system HOME_LOAN offer appears in the list
tcs.description: Verify that a HOME_LOAN offer auto-created on home-loan approval is shown in the offers list.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a buyer whose home loan was approved in Customers (so a HOME_LOAN offer exists).
tcs.steps:
1. Open the Offers list.
2. Locate the offer corresponding to HOME_LOAN (e.g. 'Home Loan Discount').
tcs.expected: A system-generated HOME_LOAN offer appears in the list; it was created by the system on home-loan approval, not via the Add New Offer drawer (BRD §4).

tcs.scenario: To verify a system VC_REQUEST offer appears in the list
tcs.description: Verify that a VC_REQUEST offer auto-created on an SM video-call outcome is shown in the list.
tcs.precond: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an SM having recorded VC_DONE_PREFERENCE or VC_2_DONE (so a VC_REQUEST offer exists).
tcs.steps:
1. Open the Offers list.
2. Locate the offer corresponding to VC_REQUEST (e.g. 'VC request').
tcs.expected: A system-generated VC_REQUEST offer appears in the list; it was auto-created by the system, not via the Add drawer (BRD §4).

tcs.scenario: To verify a future-dated offer does not apply to pricing yet
tcs.description: Verify that an offer whose Start Date is in the future is not deducted from buyer pricing.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an offer with Start Date = tomorrow applicable to a known unit typology.
tcs.steps:
1. With a future-dated offer present, open an eligible unit in Towers/allocation.
2. Inspect the All Inclusive Price breakdown.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The All Inclusive Price does NOT include the future offer (eligibility requires Start Date <= today, BRD §5.4/§7). Cross-module; confirm on a controlled session. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify an expired offer does not apply to pricing
tcs.description: Verify that an offer whose End Date has passed is not deducted from buyer pricing.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an offer with End Date = yesterday applicable to a known unit.
tcs.steps:
1. With an expired offer present, open an eligible unit in Towers/allocation.
2. Inspect the All Inclusive Price breakdown.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The expired offer is NOT deducted (eligibility requires today <= End Date, BRD §5.4/§7). Cross-module; confirm on a controlled session. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify a deactivated offer is not applied to new buyer pricing
tcs.description: Verify that an offer just toggled OFF stops being deducted from new buyer pricing.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an offer just toggled OFF and a buyer session opening an eligible unit.
tcs.steps:
1. Toggle a disposable offer OFF.
2. In a buyer session, open a unit that previously carried that discount.
3. Inspect the All Inclusive Price.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The All Inclusive Price no longer includes the deactivated offer's discount (BRD §5.1 immediate effect). Cross-module live-campaign; confirm carefully. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify toggling an offer during a live campaign re-prices immediately
tcs.description: Verify that toggling an active offer OFF during a live campaign changes buyer pricing on next price calculation.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a live campaign with an active offer and a buyer mid-selection.
tcs.steps:
1. With a buyer viewing a discounted unit, toggle the offer OFF in admin.
2. Refresh the buyer's unit view.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The buyer sees the price WITHOUT that discount on next calculation (BRD §6 race; FS Feature 4 §6). HIGH-risk live-campaign behaviour — confirm only on a controlled UAT session. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify multiple active offers stack on the Agreement Value
tcs.description: Verify that two applicable active offers are summed and deducted together from the Agreement Value.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] two active offers both applicable to the same unit typology.
tcs.steps:
1. With two applicable active offers present, open an eligible unit.
2. Inspect the All Inclusive Price breakdown.
tcs.expected: [To verify] All Inclusive Price = Agreement Value - sum of both offer discounts (BRD §5.5). Cross-module; confirm on a controlled session. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify the race when an offer is toggled OFF mid-payment
tcs.description: Verify that an offer toggled OFF between viewing pricing and submitting payment disappears from the final amount.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a buyer viewing pricing with an offer applied; admin able to toggle it OFF mid-flow.
tcs.steps:
1. Buyer views a unit with the offer applied.
2. Admin toggles the offer OFF.
3. Buyer clicks 'Proceed to Pay'.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The discount disappears from the final booking amount because eligibility is re-queried live at submit (BRD §6 / FRD §10 processOffers). Confirm on a controlled session. [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify locked bookings are not affected by offer changes
tcs.description: Verify that a completed booking's amount does not change when the offer it used is later toggled OFF or edited.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a buyer with a completed booking that used Offer X.
tcs.steps:
1. Confirm a completed booking that used Offer X.
2. Toggle Offer X OFF (or edit it).
3. Re-open the buyer's completed booking in Customers.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The completed booking's amount is unchanged; offer changes apply only to future/in-progress sessions (BRD §5.7 / FS Feature 4 §6.3). [VERIFY WITH DEV].

tcs.scenario: To verify deleting an offer does not refund existing bookings
tcs.description: Verify that deleting an offer leaves completed bookings that used it unchanged.
tcs.precond: [VERIFY WITH DEV][TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a completed booking that used Offer X, plus authorisation to delete Offer X.
tcs.steps:
1. Delete Offer X (only if authorised).
2. Open the buyer's completed booking in Customers.
tcs.expected: [To verify] The booking amount and existing transactions/registrations are unchanged by the deletion; only future pricing is affected. [VERIFY WITH DEV].
